title: ObjectForge multi-object coherent systems
completion_gates: planner compares at least three bounded system topologies
selected topology covers every mandatory system capability
at least six independently useful retained objects are delivered
at least three shared interface standards are reused across objects
all declared connections use matching standards and compatible polarities
no system object is orphaned from the compatibility graph
operational and transport workflows reference valid objects and connections
combined layout remains inside the declared footprint
all members share one design-language fingerprint per system variant
combined system GLB reopens with retained geometry
paired language variants retain one system plan and distinct model hashes
no external finished-model generator supplies geometry
benchmark: Modular Observation and Service Cell under Field Service and Precision Lab design languages
boundary: no human or robot operational simulation
